units: impacts per cm^2 per landing, anchored to Surveyor III

branch_filter.rule: keep a variant if, after calibrating K_D to the coupons' mean pit size (79 um), its absolute N(pits >= 20 um) at Surveyor III lies between 1/3 x 103/cm^2 (coupon average) and 4000/cm^2 (tube maximum), for at least one assumed counting threshold (20 or 50 um)

descent_profile.note: median over erosion laws; rings in the replay scale with this fraction
